messages.content: I forgot my password. How can I log in?
Go to the login page and select the Forgot Password option. A password reset link will be sent to your registered email address.
How do I change my registered email address?
You can update your registered email address through Account Settings. The new email address must be verified.
I want to delete my account. What should I do?
You can request account deletion through Account Settings. The deletion request must be verified before processing.
Someone accessed my account without permission. What should I do?
If you notice suspicious account activity, contact the support team. Never share your password or verification codes with anyone.
My payment failed. What should I check?
First, verify that your payment method is valid. You can also check your payment history in Billing Settings.
I was charged twice for the same transaction.
Please contact the billing support team. They will investigate the duplicate charges.
How can I request a refund?
You can submit a refund request through Billing Settings. Refund eligibility depends on the applicable refund policy.
Where can I check my subscription charges?
You can view your subscription charges and billing dates in the Subscription section.
Where can I find my payment history?
You can check your payment history in Billing Settings.
Should I share my password with the support team?
No. Never share your password or verification codes with anyone, including support representatives.
